items.title: The Week Everybody Started Talking About AI Doomsday
items.summary: It started Tuesday when an Anthropic researcher told The Wall Street Journal he was quitting.  Shortly after, a current Anthropic researcher took to X to confirm the sentiment, adding he believes the risk the human race will go extinct in the next 10 years is higher than 10%.  My colleagues Amrith Ramkumar, Lindsay Ellis and I spoke with lawmakers, church leaders and even one filmmaker who are now being called to answer some hard questions: Is this real?
